characters.name: Midori
characters.summary: Balanced Water duelist and the safest pick for learning Long Sword counters.
rotation: Open with Foresight Slash to build Spirit gauge.
Red Spirit into Helm Breaker on the head.
Refresh Water pressure before the second phase.
tips: Counter through roars instead of dodging.
Pairs well with Pipa's heal uptime.

characters.name: Luka
characters.summary: Aggressive Fire blade dancer built for short, brutal openings.
rotation: Start in Demon Mode after a mount.
Blade Dance the head, then disengage before the roar.
Keep stamina for one emergency dodge.
tips: Do not overcommit on a limping target.
Bring Constitution food for long fights.

characters.name: Pyro
characters.summary: Guard-point specialist who converts monster aggression into Fire bursts.
rotation: Bait the first charge and guard point it.
Charge the shield before spending phials.
SAED on the head after a trip.
tips: Guard points beat panic rolls.
Works best with a Support that cleanses Fireblight.

characters.name: Rhodes
characters.summary: Immovable Thunder wall that holds the line and feeds the team openings.
rotation: Open with a counter to establish aggro.
Triple poke the legs to build trips.
Save a wide sweep for adds.
tips: Your job is space, not damage.
Guard Dash through beams to save stamina.

characters.name: Ryunosuke
characters.summary: Patient Thunder executioner with the highest single-hit ceiling in the roster.
rotation: Wait for a trap or roar to start the charge.
True Charged Slash the head, then sheath.
Use Tackle to armor through the tail sweep.
tips: A whiffed TCS costs more than a skipped one.
Pair with a Hammer for stun windows.

characters.name: Keres
characters.summary: Dragon bow controller who keeps elders grounded and auras broken.
rotation: Open with a Dragon shot to the head.
Use Arc Shot to pressure the legs.
Reposition during the aura break.
tips: Keep stamina for one Power Shot burst.
Target the head only after the aura drops.

characters.name: Freya
characters.summary: Ranged Ice support with reliable para and heal ammo.
rotation: Load Para ammo for the first opening.
Ice the legs to trip the target.
Switch to heal ammo when an ally is low.
tips: Craft ammo before every hunt.
Stay behind the melee line when reloading.

characters.name: Luxheart
characters.summary: Stun-focused Fire support who opens the head for the whole team.
rotation: Upswing the head to build stun.
Big Bang after the first KO.
Reset to the head after every roar.
tips: Do not chase a flying monster.
A stun is worth more than raw damage.

characters.name: Raya
characters.summary: Mobile Ice archer who punishes long recoveries from range.
rotation: Coat Ice and aim for the head.
Power Shot after a perfect dodge.
Use the terrain to keep height.
tips: Keep one dash of stamina in reserve.
Iceblight resistance food helps a lot.

characters.name: Pepper
characters.summary: Water status skirmisher who stacks paralysis between Water bursts.
rotation: Apply Para coating on the first opening.
Blade Dance the head while the team commits.
Disengage and reapply before the second phase.
tips: Never trade hits for status buildup.
Bring Energy Drinks for paralysis recovery.

characters.name: Madelyn
characters.summary: The roster's best sustain support: Water pressure plus cleanse and heal ammo.
rotation: Open with Water ammo to soften the hide.
Keep cleanse ammo ready for blights.
Heal before the team's big window, not after.
tips: Position so both allies stay in heal range.
Reload during monster roars.

characters.name: Arkaya
characters.summary: Dragon counter duelist who turns elder aggression into Spirit gauge.
rotation: Foresight Slash the first swipe.
Helm Breaker the head on the counter window.
Keep Dragon pressure on the aura.
tips: Counter timing matters more than combo length.
Avoid countering multi-hit beams.

characters.name: Haze
characters.summary: Glass-cannon Dragon blade dancer with the fastest elder kill times.
rotation: Demon Mode immediately after a mount.
Focus the head, then the forelegs.
Leave one dodge of stamina for the roar.
tips: Bring Divine Blessing food.
Do not start a dance without a down.

characters.name: Ouyang Varen
characters.summary: Veteran Thunder support who mixes KO pressure with team buffs.
rotation: Open with an upswing to the head.
KO, then apply the team attack buff.
Return to the head after every heal.
tips: Buff before the damage window, not during it.
Keep the Hammer charged while repositioning.
